title: Maps to a finitely presented scheme descend over a fixed stage
statement: Let I be a small cofiltered category, K:I→Scheme a diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transitions, and b:T→K a limiting cone. Fix i∈I, a locally finitely presented morphism p:P→Kᵢ, and a map a:T→P with a p=bᵢ. Then there are j∈I, f:j→i, and a₀:Kⱼ→P such that bⱼ a₀=a and a₀ p=K(f). Schemes and local finite presentation are as in [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation].

proof.text: Restrict K and its cone along Over.forget i. This functor is initial (Mathlib Over.initial_forget), so Functor.Initial.isLimitWhiskerEquiv gives a limiting restricted cone. Its objects are qcqs and its transition maps affine by the original hypotheses. Give this restricted diagram its natural map t to Kᵢ by j↦K.map j.hom; naturality is functoriality and Over.w. The equality a p=bᵢ and naturality of b imply c.π≫t=const.map(a≫p). Apply Mathlib Scheme.exists_π_app_comp_eq_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation to p, c, and a. Reading the resulting object j of Over i as its domain j.left and arrow j.hom gives exactly the two asserted equalities.

proof_origin.note: The limit-reduction route is unchanged; finite torsor descent is separated from proved section descent and proved base change.

theorem exists_map_at_refinement_of_affine_limit
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I] (K : I ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    (hKqc : ∀ i, CompactSpace (K.obj i)) (hKqs : ∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (K.obj i))
    (hKa : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (K.map f))
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (b : (Functor.const I).obj T ⟶ K)
    (hb : IsLimit (Cone.mk T b)) (i : I)
    {P : Scheme.{u}} (p : P ⟶ K.obj i) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation p]
    (a : T ⟶ P) (ha : a ≫ p = b.app i) :
    ∃ (j : I) (f : j ⟶ i) (a₀ : K.obj j ⟶ P),
      b.app j ≫ a₀ = a ∧ a₀ ≫ p = K.map f
